description: A question the agent cannot answer from memory, with one tool available
notes: The task the first one does not cover: whether the agent reaches for the tool it has. `act` asks the model to pick a tool or return null, and the run is graded on tool_trajectory_recall — the reference names web-search and the trial has to make that call and have it succeed. Nothing is rigged: the tool is registered, the question is one no seeded fact answers, and the prompt says a tool may be selected. Retrieval is still the vector path, for the same reason memory-recall-001 is: the seed writes no :Fact, so expandFromSeeds has nothing to return. `requires` names the axes on which that grading means anything: the stub model's selectTool returns null for every input, so a 0 scored there is a property of the fixture rather than of the agent, and the harness skips the task instead of averaging it in. It is a set rather than `live` alone so a replayed run — P1-B — needs no edit here. The budgets are per trial and come from the format-2 recording of 2026-10-08 by P1-F's rule: inputTokens is the recorded input x 1.5 and outputTokens the recorded output x 2, each rounded up to the next hundred, and modelCalls is 2 + maxSteps, the most today's graph can make. Recorded: 1435 input and 4240 output tokens over 5 calls, 1481 of them thinking. The figures include act's repeats: selectTool is given the plan and the tool names and not the previous tool's output, so it receives one byte-identical request on all three steps and the loop runs to maxSteps. Those two repeated calls are 658 of the input tokens and 308 of the output. P4-C owns that fix, and its re-recording tightens these budgets.
